checkCertificateRevocationListOnReceive.description: The value indicating whether to check for certificate revocation list on receive.

checkCertificateRevocationListOnSend.description: The value indicating whether to check for certificate revocation list on send.

checkDuplicateMessage.description: The value indicating whether to check for duplicate message.

compressMessage.description: The value indicating whether the message has to be compressed.

encryptMessage.description: The value indicating whether the message has to be encrypted.

interchangeDuplicatesValidityDays.description: The number of days to look back for duplicate interchange.

overrideMessageProperties.description: The value indicating whether to override incoming message properties with those in agreement.

signMessage.description: The value indicating whether the message has to be signed.
